practice.name: GS Aesthetic
practice.tagline: Natural hairlines and considered skin, in Gulberg.
practice.description: Boutique hair restoration and skin clinic at 24-P, Block P, Gulberg 2, Lahore. Hairline design, FUE and FUT, scalp treatments, and a short menu of skin and colour work led by Hammad Ghafoor.
practice.whatsappMessage: Hello, I would like to book a consultation at GS Aesthetic.

hero.title: A hairline drawn for the face you will still have.
hero.emphasis: Skin work with the same restraint.
hero.lede: GS Aesthetic plans natural hair restoration and a short list of skin treatments. The drawing is agreed before a graft is taken. Colour and tightening are booked only when they suit the skin in front of us.
hero.imageAlt: Daylight reception at the Gulberg clinic, limestone and olive linen

founder.title: Hammad Ghafoor
founder.portraitAlt: Hammad Ghafoor in the Gulberg studio
paragraphs: Hammad has spent two decades on hairlines and skin in Lahore. The practice is built around one room, one drawing, and a refusal to treat a graft count as the product.

Training ran through clinical dermatology and later aesthetic practice. The work that stayed is the work that still looks like the patient: irregular hairlines, doses written down, and skin plans that start with the barrier and the sun.
Since 1999 the same practice has kept a community clinic for people who cannot pay, with free skin consultations in Shadbagh and at the Gulberg rooms when the list allows.

timeline.title: Clinical training
timeline.detail: Dermatology and trichology foundations, including time associated with Sir Ganga Ram clinical teaching.

timeline.title: Aesthetic practice
timeline.detail: Moved from general skin clinics into hairline design and non-surgical facial work.

timeline.title: Community list
timeline.detail: Free consultations for families who cannot pay, continued alongside the Gulberg practice.

timeline.title: 24-P, Gulberg 2
timeline.detail: One flagship room. Consultations are booked, not walked into a queue.

founder.philanthropy: Ask at reception if you need the community list. It is first-come on set days, for skin problems, and it is free. It is not a discounted transplant.

method.title: The edge is the whole operation.
method.lede: A transplanted hairline fails in the first centimetre: a straight row, hairs the same thickness, a line drawn too low for the age of the face. The method here is a drawing you approve, then grafts chosen to serve that drawing.
method.imageAlt: Close view of a natural hairline edge

principles.title: Age before fashion
principles.body: The line sits where it will still make sense when the rest of the hair thins. A low line borrowed from a photograph is declined.

principles.title: Singles on the edge
principles.body: The first irregular row is single hairs, not pairs. Direction follows the hair that is already there.

principles.title: Donor is finite
principles.body: We will not empty the fringe to chase a number. Large cases are staged.

principles.title: Judged at a year
principles.body: Shedding at week three is expected. Photographs at twelve months are the result, not the day-ten selfie.

steps.title: Sit up and draw
steps.body: The hairline is drawn with you upright, in a mirror, in daylight. You leave with the drawing even if you do not book.

steps.title: Count what the drawing needs
steps.body: Graft numbers come from the area and the density, not from a package.

steps.title: Take only the safe fringe
steps.body: FUE or a strip, chosen for how you wear your hair. The donor is photographed before and after.

steps.title: Place, then wait
steps.body: Day-ten review for crusts and direction. Growth is discussed at four months and judged at twelve.

services.imageAlt: Follicular unit extraction at GS Aesthetic
howItWorks: Consultation with density count, donor check, and a drawn hairline you approve in a mirror.
Local anaesthetic. Extraction with a small punch. No strip, no linear scar.
Site making that follows the natural exit angle of neighbouring hair.
Placement of singles on the edge, then two- and three-hair grafts behind.
Written wash plan for the first ten days and a review at day 10.
visit: Eat a normal breakfast. Wash your hair the night before. Do not cut it extremely short unless asked.
Tell us about blood thinners, isotretinoin, and any previous transplant.
Plan a quiet evening. You leave the same day with a light dressing on the donor.
aftercare: Sleep with the head raised for five nights.
Spray the recipient with the saline we give you. Do not pick crusts.
Gym, swimming, and direct sun wait two weeks.
The transplanted hair sheds. That is the follicle resetting, not a failed graft.

faqs.q: How many grafts will I need?
faqs.a: A modest hairline and temples often sit between 1,800 and 2,800 grafts. A full front plus mid-scalp can need more than one sitting so the donor is not over-harvested.
FUE leaves dot marks in the donor that are usually hidden at a short fade. We do not promise an invisible donor if you shave to the skin.

faqs.q: When does it look like hair?
faqs.a: Early growth starts around month four. The result is judged at twelve months, when calibre and direction have settled.

services.name: Follicular unit extraction
services.summary: Individual grafts taken from the donor fringe and placed into a hairline drawn for your face, age, and future loss.
services.downtime: Redness 7–10 days. Shed at week 3. Growth from month 4.
services.idealFor: Men and women with a stable donor area who want an unshaven or short-fade donor.
overview: FUE at this clinic is a design appointment first and a graft count second. Hammad maps the temporal points, the mid-frontal peak, and the direction the hair already wants to grow, then extracts only what that drawing needs.

Punches stay in the safe donor zone above the nape and behind the ears. Grafts are kept moist, sorted by hair count, and placed so singles form the edge and doubles sit just behind it. The aim is a hairline that still looks correct in ten years, not a low line that ages badly.

services.imageAlt: Follicular unit transplantation at GS Aesthetic
howItWorks: Hairline drawing and donor laxity check.
Suture removal and donor review on day 10.
visit: Wear a button-front shirt.
Arrange a driver if you prefer not to go home alone.
Stop discussing graft numbers as a score. The drawing decides the number.
aftercare: Keep the donor dry for 48 hours.
No neck strain or heavy lifting for two weeks.
The line fades over months. It is a line, and we say so before you book.

faqs.a: Some donors cannot spare a wide FUE harvest. A strip protects the surrounding density and can yield more grafts in one day.

faqs.q: Can I fade the back later?
faqs.a: Not if the line must stay invisible. If you want a skin fade, we plan FUE instead.

services.name: Follicular unit transplantation
services.summary: A single donor strip for people who wear their hair longer and want the maximum grafts in one day.
services.downtime: Sutures out at day 10. Linear donor line hidden under longer hair.
services.idealFor: Patients who keep hair over 3 cm at the back and need a large session.
overview: FUT is still the right operation when the donor must give a large number of grafts without thinning the whole fringe. A narrow strip is taken from the densest band, closed in a fine line, and dissected under magnification into natural follicular units.

The hairline rules are the same as FUE. Singles on the edge, irregular placement, no straight planted row. We recommend FUT only after you have seen where the line will sit in a mirror and agreed you can keep hair over it.

howItWorks: Macro photographs of the current edge.
Day-10 check of the edge only.
visit: Bring old operative notes if you have them.
Do not dye the hair the week before.
aftercare: No caps that rub the edge for ten days.
Baby shampoo from day three, poured, not rubbed.

faqs.q: Is this the same as DHI?
faqs.a: No. Micro FUE describes the punch and the edge design. Implanter pens are a placement tool we use when the angle needs it, not a different operation.

services.name: Micro FUE
services.summary: A finer punch and denser edge work for hairlines, temples, and small repairs of an older transplant.
services.downtime: Similar to FUE, often less donor clipping.
services.idealFor: Hairline refinement, female temples, and repair of pluggy old work.
overview: Micro FUE uses a smaller punch and a slower pace so the first 1 cm of the hairline can be built from the finest single-hair grafts. It is the sitting we use when the problem is the edge, not a bald crown.
Repair cases start by deciding what to leave. Old plugs are sometimes left and softened with fine hair in front of them. Removing every old graft is rarely the kindest plan for the donor.

services.imageAlt: Direct hair implantation at GS Aesthetic
visit: Expect a longer day than a small FUE. Loading the pens takes time.
aftercare: Do not comb the recipient for two weeks.
Existing hair can be washed gently around the grafts.

faqs.a: The donor is still FUE. The recipient has no separate slit marks, but the skin still reddens while grafts settle.

services.name: Direct hair implantation
services.summary: Implanter-pen placement for tight angles along the hairline and between existing hairs.
services.downtime: Same recovery curve as FUE.
services.idealFor: People who still have hair in the recipient and need grafts placed between them.
overview: DHI is a way of placing grafts, not a new biology. Each graft is loaded into a choi-style implanter and set at a controlled depth and angle. That control matters between existing hairs, where a pre-made slit can cut a neighbouring follicle.
We still extract with FUE. The pen does not increase survival by itself. Handling, hydration, and a hairline that matches your age do.

services.imageAlt: Beard and moustache restoration at GS Aesthetic
howItWorks: Drawing while you are sitting, not lying down.
Singles at the border of the patch.
visit: Arrive with a few days of growth so we can see direction.
Tell us if you have keloid scars.
aftercare: No shaving for four weeks.
Sleep on your back.
The new beard sheds, then returns coarser over months.

faqs.q: Can I shave it to the skin later?
faqs.a: Yes, after it has grown through. Early shaving pulls grafts.

services.name: Beard and moustache restoration
services.summary: Scalp donor placed into patchy cheeks, a weak moustache, or a scar in the beard.
services.downtime: Stubble redness for 7–14 days. Shaving waits a month.
services.idealFor: Patchy genetic beards and scars that will not take a clean shave.
overview: Beard hair and scalp hair are not the same calibre. We say that before the drawing. Scalp donor can still build a believable cheek and a moustache if the direction follows the way beard hair lies: downward on the cheek, outward at the moustache.
Density is planned for a short beard, not a photograph taken the week after surgery. Overpacking the cheek marks the skin.

howItWorks: Harvest of the finest donor hairs.
Asymmetric count so the pair matches.
Trim lesson at the first growth visit.
visit: Do not wax or thread for three weeks before.
Bring a photo of your brows from before the loss if you have one.
aftercare: No brow gel or pencil on the grafts for ten days.
Trim, do not pluck, the new hairs.

faqs.a: No. These are growing hairs. The shape is softer and it needs trimming. Pigment is a different service.

services.name: Eyebrow restoration
services.summary: Fine single-hair grafts for over-plucked, scarred, or genetically thin brows.
services.downtime: Small scabs for a week. Brows need trimming forever because scalp hair grows long.
services.idealFor: Stable brow loss, not active alopecia areata.
overview: Eyebrow work fails when the hairs are planted straight up. Each graft has to lie flat, heads toward the tail, with a change of direction at the arch. We use only single-hair grafts and a conservative outline you can live with without makeup.
Scalp hair in a brow must be trimmed. We treat that as part of the consent, not a surprise at month six.

howItWorks: Spin and injection in a grid.
visit: Drink water. Eat. Avoid anti-inflammatory tablets the day before if your doctor agrees.
aftercare: No dye or helmet pressure for 24 hours.
You can work the same day.

faqs.a: Three to start. Maintenance is usually two or three times a year if the photographs improve.

services.name: Scalp PRP
services.summary: Your own platelets, spun and placed into thinning scalp to support hair you still have.
services.downtime: Tender scalp for a day. No hiding.
services.idealFor: Early thinning, and as support after a transplant. Not a substitute for a hairline that is already gone.
overview: PRP is a maintenance treatment. A small blood draw is spun, and the platelet-rich portion is injected across the thinning zone. It does not create a hairline where follicles have disappeared.
We book a course of three sessions a month apart, then judge photographs, not a promise of density. If the pattern needs grafts, we say so at the first visit.

visit: Arrive with the haircut you actually wear.
No alcohol the night before.
aftercare: Keep the scalp dry for four days.
No sauna or swimming for ten days.
Use the sunscreen we specify. Sun fades pigment.

faqs.a: It is pigment in the upper skin, placed as dots rather than lines. It fades and needs a refresh every few years.

services.name: Scalp pigmentation
services.summary: Pointillist pigment that restores the look of closely cropped hair or camouflages a donor.
services.duration: Two or three sittings of 2–3 hours
services.downtime: Mild redness for two days. Colour settles over a month.
services.idealFor: Cropped styles, scar camouflage, and adding the look of density between grafts.
overview: SMP is ink, not hair. The skill is the dot: small, irregular, and matched to a colour that will not turn blue. We use it to soften a wide donor, to give a shaved look, or to darken the spaces between a thin transplant.
It is the wrong choice if you want length. Pigment does not grow. We draw the hairline higher than a graft hairline, because ink cannot be combed.

services.imageAlt: Scalp exosome support at GS Aesthetic
howItWorks: Book only if the first review justifies it.
visit: Come with a clean scalp, no fibre powder or spray.
aftercare: Leave the scalp alone for the evening.
Continue your normal wash from the next morning.

faqs.q: Will this regrow a bald crown?
faqs.a: No. If the crown is smooth and shiny, the honest option is grafts or a decision to leave it.

services.name: Scalp exosome support
services.summary: A clinic-applied serum used alongside PRP or a transplant for the early months of growth.
services.downtime: None beyond a damp scalp.
services.idealFor: Patients already in a transplant or PRP plan who want an added scalp treatment.
overview: Exosome serums are an adjunct. We do not sell them as a stand-alone cure for baldness. In this clinic they are applied to a prepared scalp during the months when transplanted hair is shedding and new growth has not started.
You will be told the product name, the batch, and what it is not licensed to claim. If a simpler plan is enough, we stop at PRP.

services.imageAlt: Laser hair reduction at GS Aesthetic
howItWorks: Skin and hair check, including recent sun.
Shave the area the night before, not wax.
Test spot when the skin is new to us.
visit: No waxing or threading for four weeks.
Stop retinoids on the area as advised.
Come without makeup on the treatment zone.
aftercare: Cool the skin. No hot showers that night.
SPF every morning on treated face.
Expect shedding of treated hairs over two weeks. That is the result, not new growth.

faqs.a: It is a long-term reduction. Hormones, especially on the female face, can wake new hairs. Maintenance sittings are part of an honest plan.

services.name: Laser hair reduction
services.summary: Medical laser for unwanted facial and body hair, planned around your skin tone and a real course of sittings.
services.downtime: Warmth for a few hours. No sun on the area.
services.idealFor: Dark hair on skin that has not been tanned. Grey hair does not respond.
overview: Hair reduction is a course, usually six to eight sittings, spaced to the growth cycle of that area. We match the device settings to your skin and refuse a session if you are tanned or using photosensitive medicines.
Faces, beards you want to thin, underarms, and bikini lines are planned separately. Settings for a cheek are not settings for a leg.

visit: No active cold sore. Tell us if you are prone to them.
Arrive without makeup.
aftercare: No acids or retinoid for five days.
SPF.
Makeup the next day if the skin is calm.

faqs.a: The nickname is not how we book it. You get a named plan, a count of sessions, and photographs.

services.name: Facial PRP
services.summary: Platelets placed into tired facial skin for texture and a quieter surface, not a new face shape.
services.downtime: Speckled redness for 24–48 hours.
services.idealFor: Dull texture, early crepe skin, and patients who want to avoid filler.
overview: Facial PRP does not lift a jaw and it does not replace lost fat. Used on the right skin it can make texture look rested: finer pores in photographs, a less papery cheek.
A course of three is the minimum we judge. One session is a sample, not a result.

howItWorks: Pass with the crystal or diamond head.
SPF and a written pause on acids.
visit: Stop scrubs for a week.
Tell us every product on your shelf. Most congestion starts there.
aftercare: No gym sweat and no makeup for the evening.
Moisturiser and SPF only for three days.

faqs.a: It softens rough edges. Ice-pick scars need a different plan, and we will say so.

services.name: Microdermabrasion
services.summary: A controlled polish for rough texture and blocked pores when the skin barrier is healthy.
services.downtime: Pink for a few hours.
services.idealFor: Thick, dull skin. Not for rosacea flares or a broken barrier.
overview: This is a mechanical polish, useful when skin looks dusty and congested and useless when skin is already angry. We check the barrier first. If you are red, peeling from retinoid, or sunburnt, the appointment becomes a barrier plan instead.
A single polish brightens for a week. Texture changes when it is part of a short course and a simple home routine.

services.imageAlt: Acne and pigment clinic at GS Aesthetic
howItWorks: History, including hormones and fragrance allergy.
Photographs in the same light each visit.
In-clinic peel only when the barrier allows.
Review at six weeks, not six days.
visit: Bring the creams you own, including the ones from the pharmacy.
No new facial the week before.
aftercare: SPF reapplied if you are outside.
No steam facials during a pigment plan.
Stop if the skin burns. Message us before adding another acid.

faqs.a: We do not use drips for pigment. Melasma is treated on the skin, with sun control. Drips are a separate, limited service and not a bleach.

services.name: Acne and pigment clinic
services.summary: A diagnosis-led plan for breakouts and patchy pigment, with medicines, peels, and sun rules written down.
services.downtime: Depends on the peel or medicine. Many plans have none.
services.idealFor: Active acne, post-acne marks, and melasma that has already been irritated by random creams.
overview: Acne and melasma are managed, not erased in an afternoon. The first visit separates active disease from marks, checks what you have already put on the skin, and stops the products that are making the barrier worse.

Melasma in Lahore is a sun disease as much as a pigment disease. No peel is booked until the SPF habit is real. Hydroquinone, azelaic acid, and gentle peels are chosen to the patch, not from a menu on the wall.

howItWorks: Mild acid chosen to oil level.
SPF if you are leaving in daylight.
visit: Tell us about rosacea and recent peels.
Come without a fresh tan.
aftercare: Leave the skin alone that night.
No new retinol for 48 hours.

faqs.q: Will I glow for a wedding?
faqs.a: Yes, in the sense of cleaner, more hydrated skin. It will not change your bone structure or your skin colour.

services.name: Hydrating facial
services.summary: Cleanse, a mild acid, extraction where pores are blocked, and a water-binding finish. No steam theatre.
services.downtime: None. Makeup can go on after.
services.idealFor: Dehydrated city skin and congested chins before an event.
overview: The facial is a proper clean of the skin you have, not a whitening ritual. We extract only what is ready, keep acids mild, and finish with humectants. If your skin is sensitised, the facial becomes a calm treatment and we skip the extraction.
Book it the day before an event, not the morning of one. Skin looks best the next day.

howItWorks: Listen to the request without agreeing to it.
Explain what oral glutathione can and cannot do.
Write a sun and topical plan if pigment is the issue.
visit: Bring previous drip records if you have had them elsewhere.
aftercare: Follow the topical plan.
Do not add unmarked whitening creams. Many contain steroid.

faqs.q: Why is this on the menu?
faqs.a: Because patients ask, and a clear refusal with an alternative is better than a drip menu.

services.name: Antioxidant consultation
services.summary: A supervised look at oral antioxidant support. We do not sell skin-bleaching drips.
services.downtime: None for oral plans.
services.idealFor: Patients asking about glow who need an honest limit on what antioxidants can do.
overview: People ask for glutathione because they have been promised a lighter face. That is not a service here. What we will do is look at pigment, sun, and routine, and discuss whether an oral antioxidant has any role beside a real pigment plan.
Intravenous skin lightening is not offered. If that is the only request, the consultation ends with a no, and with a plan for the actual problem if you want one.

services.imageAlt: HIFU skin tightening at GS Aesthetic
howItWorks: Photographs and a pinch test of laxity.
Ultrasound passes at the agreed depth.
visit: No active skin infection.
Tell us about metal implants and pacemakers.
Come without heavy makeup.
aftercare: No firm massage for a week.
SPF.
Do not judge it in the car park. Swelling is not the result.

faqs.a: Usually one, reviewed at three months. A second pass is booked only if the photographs justify it.

services.name: HIFU skin tightening
services.summary: Focused ultrasound for early jaw and brow laxity. A lift measured in millimetres, judged at three months.
services.downtime: Tenderness for a few days. No social downtime.
services.idealFor: Mild laxity. Not a replacement for surgery when the neck has fallen.
overview: HIFU heats a deep layer of tissue so it contracts a little and lays down collagen slowly. The result, when it suits the face, is a sharper jaw in photographs at three months. It will not remove a heavy neck or replace a surgical lift.
We mark the face, avoid nerve paths, and turn the energy down over thin skin. Pain is a signal to adjust, not a sign that it is working harder.

services.imageAlt: Filler and wrinkle-relaxer clinic at GS Aesthetic
howItWorks: Photographs at rest and in expression.
Mirror check before more is added.
Written aftercare and a review date.
visit: No dental work in the past fortnight.
Tell us about autoimmune disease and previous filler, including the brand.
aftercare: No exercise, alcohol, or face-down sleep that night.
Do not massage unless we show you.
Call if the skin blanches, mottles, or hurts in a new way.

faqs.a: Not if the plan is small. If you want a large change in one visit, we will not be the right clinic.

services.name: Filler and wrinkle-relaxer clinic
services.summary: Small amounts of hyaluronic acid and botulinum toxin for structure and expression lines. Doses written down.
services.downtime: Needle marks for a day. Filler can swell for a week.
services.idealFor: Patients who can describe the line or the hollow, not a filtered face.
overview: This clinic uses filler to replace a specific hollow and toxin to soften a specific pull. We do not fill cheeks until a face looks different in photographs of the same person. You will see the product, the batch, and the amount.
Lips, tear troughs, and noses are declined when the anatomy is wrong for a needle. A no is part of the service.

howItWorks: Passes until the therapeutic warmth is reached.
Next visit in one to two weeks.
visit: Remove metal jewellery.
No fresh injectables in the area.
aftercare: SPF.
Keep retinoid to your usual nights unless the skin is warm.

faqs.a: No. Book the course or do not start.

services.name: Radiofrequency firming
services.summary: A course of controlled heat for crepey skin on the lower face, when ultrasound is more than you need.
services.downtime: Warmth for an hour.
services.idealFor: Early crepe, and maintenance after HIFU.
overview: Radiofrequency warms the skin more superficially than HIFU. It suits crepey texture and a mild loss of snap. Results are cumulative, so the booking is a course with photographs at the start and the end.
We do not stack it in the same week as a peel or filler.

services.imageAlt: Tinted skin finish at GS Aesthetic
howItWorks: Patch of colour matched, not lightened.
Photographs so you can see the fade yourself.
visit: No acids for five days before.
Come with the shade you actually want to look like in daylight.
aftercare: No scrubbing.
SPF.
Expect it to leave. Booking a top-up every week is how the skin gets injured.

faqs.a: Days to about two weeks. Anything promising permanence is not this treatment.

services.name: Tinted skin finish
services.summary: A light cosmetic tint worked into the surface for a short-lived evenness. It is makeup that lasts days, not a new complexion.
services.downtime: Pink for a day. Tint fades over one to two weeks.
services.idealFor: A short event window. Not for melasma, and not as a whitening treatment.
overview: BB glow is marketed elsewhere as a permanent lighter face. Here it is described as it behaves: a tint in the very surface that fades. We will not perform it over active melasma, eczema, or a damaged barrier.
If the request is a lighter skin tone, the appointment becomes the pigment clinic instead.

howItWorks: Pigment and wipe-back until the colour is even.
Heal, then perfect at six weeks.
visit: No brow tint or henna for two weeks.
No retinoid on the brow for a week.
Tell us about isotretinoin in the past year.
aftercare: Keep the brow dry and unpicked.
No brow makeup until the perfecting visit.
SPF once healed. Sun shifts pigment.

faqs.a: Typically 12–18 months before a colour refresh, faster on oily skin.

services.name: Eyebrow microblading
services.summary: Hair-like strokes of pigment for sparse brows, mapped to the bone structure you have.
services.duration: 2 hours, plus a perfecting visit at 6 weeks
services.downtime: Darker and sharper for a week, then it softens.
services.idealFor: Sparse brows with healthy skin. Not over active acne in the brow or keloid tendency.
overview: The drawing takes longer than the blading. You approve the shape sitting up, in daylight, before any pigment is opened. Strokes follow the direction of the hairs you still have.
Pigment is chosen a shade softer than you think, because fresh strokes always look darker. A six-week perfecting visit is part of the fee, not an upsell.

howItWorks: Colour test on the arm and a sheer pass on the lip.
visit: Start antivirals if you are prone to cold sores.
Come well hydrated. Dry lips take pigment badly.
aftercare: The provided balm only.
No spice, no kissing, no lipstick while the skin is peeling.
The first week is not the colour.

faqs.a: Only while they are swollen. The settled result is colour, not volume.

services.name: Lip blush
services.summary: A soft pigment wash that restores the colour of the lip you have. It does not draw a new, larger mouth.
services.downtime: Dry, darker lips for five days. Colour settles in a month.
services.idealFor: Pale or uneven lip colour. Not during a cold-sore outbreak.
overview: Lip blush sits inside your natural border. We do not extend the vermilion to imitate a filler result. Colour is tested and agreed before the lip is numbed, because numb lips look bigger than they are.
If you get cold sores, you need antiviral cover from your doctor before the day. We will not start on a tingle.

services.imageAlt: Hybrid FUT and FUE at GS Aesthetic

faqs.q: Who is Hybrid FUT and FUE for?
faqs.a: Large restorations where the donor must be used carefully.

Message the clinic on WhatsApp with a daylight photo of the area and the name of this treatment. The first visit is a consultation, not a procedure dropped into the same hour unless the diary allows it.

services.name: Hybrid FUT and FUE
services.summary: A strip plus a selective FUE harvest when one method alone cannot supply the drawing.
services.downtime: Donor line plus dot marks. Sutures out at day 10.
services.idealFor: Large restorations where the donor must be used carefully.
overview: Hybrid surgery takes a narrow strip from the densest band and then extracts additional grafts by FUE around it. It is chosen when the hairline drawing needs more grafts than either method should give alone.
The design rules do not change. Singles still make the edge. The hybrid decision is about the donor, and it is explained with photographs before you book.
howItWorks: FUE from the remaining safe fringe.
One placement plan for both harvests.
Day-10 review of the line and the dots.
visit: Plan the whole day.
Wear a button-front shirt.
You will be told which part of the donor does which job.
aftercare: Two different donor aftercares: a line and a field of dots.
No gym for two weeks.
Do not judge density before month twelve.

services.imageAlt: Body hair transplant at GS Aesthetic

faqs.q: Who is Body hair transplant for?
faqs.a: Repair cases with a limited scalp donor, not a first hairline.

Message the clinic on WhatsApp with a daylight photo of the area and the name of this treatment. The first visit is a consultation, not a procedure dropped into the same hour unless the diary allows it.

services.name: Body hair transplant
services.summary: Chest or beard donor used only when the scalp fringe is already thin.
services.downtime: Donor redness on the body for one to two weeks.

blogs.title: What happens in a hairline consultation
blogs.excerpt: The drawing, the donor, and the number. In that order.
body: A consultation at GS Aesthetic starts with you upright, in daylight, in a mirror. The hairline is drawn before anyone says a graft count.
The donor is photographed. If the fringe cannot support the drawing, the drawing changes or the surgery waits. A package that starts from a number is how people end up with a line that is too low.
You can leave with the drawing and book later. The consult is the work, not a formality before a sale.

blogs.title: Why transplanted hair sheds
blogs.excerpt: Week three looks like failure. It is the follicle resetting.
body: The hairs placed on the day of surgery are strands. The follicle under them goes quiet and the strand falls. That is expected between week two and week six.
New growth is discussed around month four and judged at month twelve. Sending a worried photograph at week three is welcome. Starting a second surgery then is not.
Day ten is for crusts and direction. Twelve months is for the result.

blogs.title: Melasma, and why the peel can wait
blogs.excerpt: Pigment plans start with the hour you spend outside.
body: Melasma darkens with light and with heat. A peel on a face that has no sunscreen habit is how patches get worse.
The first prescription is often a stop: stop the steroid whitening cream, stop the steam facial, start a real SPF.
Procedures come after the photographs show the skin can tolerate them.

blogs.title: Strokes, powder, or both
blogs.excerpt: Three brow services, and who each one suits.
body: Microblading draws hairs. It suits skin that is not very oily and a person who wants the brow to look like hair up close.
Powder is a soft fill, stronger in photographs, faster to fade on oily skin. Combo puts strokes at the head and powder through the body.
All three need a drawing you approve sitting up, and all three need a perfecting visit. The day you leave is not the colour you keep.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body: GS Aesthetic runs the clinic site at gsaesthetic.online from 24-P, Block P, Gulberg 2, Lahore. Questions about this policy go to hello@gsaesthetic.online.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: If you message us on WhatsApp, call, or email, we receive the name, number, and the concern you send, including any photograph you choose to attach. The site itself does not run a public account system. The studio desk keeps an admin session cookie on the editor’s browser only.

sections.heading: Why we use it
sections.body: We use those details to answer you, book a visit, and keep a clinical record if you become a patient. We do not sell lists of enquiries. We do not use them for unrelated advertising.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.body: Enquiry messages are kept while the booking is open and for a short period after, unless a consultation becomes part of a clinical record. Clinical records are kept for the period required for medical notes in Pakistan.

sections.heading: Sharing
sections.body: WhatsApp is operated by Meta. If you write to us there, that message is also handled under WhatsApp’s own terms. We do not pass your photographs to other clinics. A laboratory or a referred doctor receives only what the referral needs, and only with your knowledge.

sections.heading: Your requests
sections.body: You can ask what we hold about an enquiry, ask for a correction, or ask us to delete an enquiry that never became a clinical record. Write to hello@gsaesthetic.online. Clinical notes may have to be retained even if you would prefer them deleted.

sections.heading: The site
sections.body: gsaesthetic.online describes the services of GS Aesthetic. It is information, not a diagnosis and not a confirmed booking. A treatment happens only after a consultation in the clinic and your agreement to that plan.

sections.heading: Bookings
sections.body: A WhatsApp message asks for a time. It does not hold a time until the clinic confirms it. Please arrive as agreed or tell us if you cannot. Repeated missed visits may be refused a further booking.

sections.heading: Photographs and copy
sections.body: Text, the logo, and photographs on this site belong to the clinic unless a caption says otherwise. Do not copy the logo or present our pages as your own clinic.

sections.heading: Prices
sections.body: Any fee discussed in a message is an estimate until it is written at the consultation. Packages are not sold from the website.

sections.heading: Liability
sections.body: We take care with what we publish. We are not liable for decisions you make from the website alone, or for a third-party service such as WhatsApp, Instagram, or a map link being unavailable.

sections.heading: Not a diagnosis
sections.body: Pages about hair, skin, injections, and salon work describe what the clinic offers. They do not diagnose you. Results vary. A photograph on this site is of the studio or a teaching detail, not a promise that your result will match it.

sections.heading: Individual plans
sections.body: Graft numbers, doses, peels, and courses are decided in the room after an examination. If a treatment is wrong for you, the clinic will say so. That refusal is part of the care.

sections.heading: Emergencies
sections.body: This website and WhatsApp are not an emergency service. If you have chest pain, trouble breathing, a rapidly spreading rash, or bleeding you cannot control, seek urgent medical care.

sections.heading: After a procedure
sections.body: Follow the written aftercare you were given. If skin blanches, mottles, or hurts in a new way after an injection, contact the clinic at once and, if you cannot reach us, go to an emergency department.

sections.heading: What a cookie is
sections.body: A cookie is a small file stored by your browser. This public site does not set advertising or analytics cookies.

sections.heading: The only cookie we set
sections.body: If a member of staff signs into the studio desk, the browser stores an httpOnly session cookie named hmd_admin. It expires after seven days or when they sign out. Visitors who only read the site do not receive it.

sections.heading: Third parties
sections.body: If you leave for WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, or Google Maps, those sites set their own cookies under their own policies. We do not control them.
